standard_prerequisites.use: Produces an index i at which the base-changed morphism f_i is syntomic.

standard_prerequisites.name: Syntomic relative dimension and constructible containment
standard_prerequisites.use: Decomposes X_i into open-and-closed relative-dimension pieces, shows the limit X maps into the dimension-1 piece, and descends that containment to some finite level.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent of unramifiedness
standard_prerequisites.use: Promotes the unramifiedness of Sing(f) over Y, known after base change to Y, back to some finite level i'.

core_obligations: Syntomic stage (proof lines 5112-5120): for some i the morphism f_i is syntomic, hence decomposes into open-and-closed pieces X_{i,d} of relative dimension d, and the base-change behaviour of fibre dimensions shows X maps into X_{i,1}.
Containment descent (proof lines 5121-5130): the limit containment into the constructible X_{i,1} descends to some i' >= i, making f_{i'} syntomic of relative dimension 1.

Unramified stage (proof lines 5131-5138): Sing(f_{i'}) -> Y_{i'} becomes unramified after base change to Y, so by the unramified-descent lemma it is unramified at some finite level, finishing the proof.
proof_roadmap: Descend syntomicness to a finite level and decompose by relative dimension.
Identify the dimension-one piece via fibre-dimension behaviour under base change.
Descend the containment of the limit in the dimension-one piece.
Descend the unramifiedness of the singular locus and conclude.

Every step is present with no omissions. H2: systematic application of the standard limit-descent lemmas in correct order.
